nuggets.text: The Boilermakers and Wake Forest are the only two FBS teams that wear Old Gold and Black.
Ryan Browne threw for a career-high 317 yards and three touchdowns in the Boilermakers' 44-19 opener.
Boilermakers QB Ryan Browne is the son of former NFL fullback Jim Browne.
Ryan Browne committed to North Carolina in December 2024, then transferred back to Purdue four months later.
Asaad Waseem caught six passes for 107 yards in his Boilermakers debut after transferring from Florida Atlantic.
The Boilermakers' marching band has played the World's Largest Drum since 1921.
The Boilermaker Special mascot borrows a railroad term: a special was an extra train run off the timetable.
When Drew Brees won Super Bowl XLIV, Purdue became the second college with three different Super Bowl-winning QBs.
Boilermakers coach Barry Odom won nine games in his first season at UNLV, the Rebels' most since 1979.
The Boilermakers lead the series with Wake Forest 4-1 and are 3-1 against the Deacons in West Lafayette.
